item_name: Rothco Hook and Loop Inner Duty Belt
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Hook & Loop Inner Duty Belt provides essential support for law enforcement and public safety personnel. With a full-length hook & loop closure, it securely attaches to your tactical duty belt, reinforcing your loadout for optimal performance. This belt is fully adjustable and available in 3 different size ranges, accommodating a variety of body types for a comfortable fit. Measuring 1.5 inches wide, it fits most standard-sized belt loops, ensuring compatibility with a range of tactical gear.
